_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for slide -> deck asset. THE RULE (every master follows it): never hardcode an asset path in a slide component; the mapping lives here. A slide reorder or asset swap is a ONE-LINE edit in this file, so Drive and the code cannot silently drift apart. `content` records what the asset actually shows, so when a slide moves a human can confirm the move is correct. Boundary with knowledge#2547: the slide REGISTRY owns slide ORDER and identity; this manifest owns slide -> ASSET only — do not duplicate order here.

drive.note: Deck source assets are renamed slide-N in DECK-ready so Drive reads at-a-glance which ones are shown. Drive ids were matched to the committed repo assets by byte-exact size + type. Candidate versions Tyler is still choosing among (slide4-antibrainrot-v2..v4, extra hero angles, extra hf_ videos) are intentionally left un-renamed. Slide 5's poster is Izzu's (knowledge#2542) and is not in this folder.
